title: Benny the Rabbit and the Lost Carrot

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who is hiding in this hole?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look at those long ears! Can you guess?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's... a rabbit!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Hello! I'm Benny the rabbit!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Benny! I'm Bobo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Rabbits are very quiet. But when they want to say, watch out, they do this.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Thump! Thump!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you thump your feet like Benny? Your turn!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Thump, thump!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's learn three rabbit facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact one. Rabbits can turn their big ears, to listen in different directions.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact two. Rabbits mostly eat grass and hay. Carrots are just a special treat!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact three. When a rabbit is very happy, it jumps and twists in the air. That's called a binky!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Wheee! Binky!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Today, Benny has a special treat. One big, orange carrot!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: I'm saving my carrot for a picnic, with my friend Bobo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Benny puts the carrot by the tree, and hops off to get a blanket.

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: I'm back! Oh no... my carrot is gone!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Benny feels sad.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Don't worry, Benny! Friends help each other. Let's look together!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Is it under the bush? No...

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Is it behind the rock? No...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then, Benny turns his big ears. Shh! Listen...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Crunch... crunch... crunch!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: I hear something! Over there!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's Pip, the little mouse, nibbling the carrot!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Oh! I'm sorry. I was so hungry. I didn't know it was yours.

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: That's okay, Pip. Let's share it! There's enough for everyone.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: So Benny, Bobo and Pip had a picnic, all together.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Thank you, Benny! You're a good friend.

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Sharing with friends is the best. Binky!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Good friends help each other, and share.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, let's play and remember, with Benny!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How does a rabbit say, watch out?

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Thump, thump!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Thump your feet!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Thump, thump!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Do you remember the rabbit facts?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What do rabbits mostly eat?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Grass and hay!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And carrots are just a treat.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What can a rabbit do with its big ears?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Turn them, to listen!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What is a happy rabbit jump called?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A binky!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you do a binky? Jump, and twist! Your turn!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Wheee!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Friends help each other!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Friends help each other!

vo.speaker: benny
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Thump, thump!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bye-bye!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How do YOU help your friends?
